trades.displayTradeName: Electronic Discharge Machine (EDM) - Wire and Sinker Programmer/Operator
trades.description: An Electronic Discharge Machine EDM Wire and Sinker Programmer Operator uses computer-controlled machines to shape metal parts with tiny electrical sparks. They read blueprints, program wire and sinker EDM equipment, set up workpieces, choose cutting settings, and check precise measurements. Their work makes accurate tools, molds, and machine parts that keep manufacturing equipment running properly.
